summary.text: Brandon Davis is the Republican candidate for Nevada State Assembly District 34 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Hanadi Nadeem.
A Las Vegas digital marketing business owner, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he founded the watchdog organization DOGE NEVADA in 2025.

paragraphs.text: Davis was born in Rockford, Illinois, earned a high school diploma from Auburn High School and attended Southern Illinois University.
His career experience includes marketing, digital advertising, communications and technology, and he is the founder and CEO of MNGR, a Las Vegas digital marketing agency.

In his 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he has run the agency since 2015 and that in 2025 the Clark County School District Board of Trustees appointed him to represent District E on the district's Attendance Zone Advisory Commission.
Davis won the June 11, 2024 Republican primary for Nevada State Assembly District 34 over Clement Ziroli III and was the Republican nominee in that year's general election.

In his 2026 survey, he listed responsible government spending, lower costs, stronger schools and expanded affordable health care as his key messages, and said he is passionate about education, economic opportunity and government accountability.
